subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API once the session-targeting and SDK contract blockers are fixed?
rationale: The patch creates a new authenticated Gateway endpoint and optional plugin API, which is a durable product/API boundary decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve after blockers are fixed
options.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, SDK barrel exports, documentation, conflict refresh, and focused regression coverage before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first API
options.body: Land only the read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor subset and defer admin rotate until the control-plane semantics are settled.

options.title: Defer core control
options.body: Pause or close this core PR if context-engine maintenance should remain plugin/private until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers are fixed
recommendation.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, SDK barrel exports, documentation, conflict refresh, and focused regression coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points to this owner on the central Gateway session-key and method-scope surfaces involved in the decision.
